iteration 01 FP-5 selection gate (native coder). Preserved verbatim; it records the raw library
behaviour that motivates the handler guards and is NOT a result of the guarded implementation.

----- source (main.go) -----
// Probe for the FP-5 selection gate (risk-spikes.md "Selection gate").
// Scratch-only; not part of the repository. Uses go-git v5.16.3 server sessions
// and packp codecs behind a minimal smart-HTTP wrapper over TLS; no git executable.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/pem"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"github.com/go-git/go-billy/v5/memfs"
	"github.com/go-git/go-billy/v5/osfs"
	git "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/config"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/cache"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/format/packfile"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/format/pktline"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/object"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/protocol/packp"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/protocol/packp/capability"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/revlist"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/transport"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/transport/server"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/storage/filesystem"
	"github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/storage/memory"
)

func must(err error, what string) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("FATAL %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func main() {
	empty, _ := os.MkdirTemp("", "emptypath")
	os.Setenv("PATH", empty)
	_, lerr := exec.LookPath("git")
	fmt.Printf("PATH=%s LookPath(git) err=%v\n", empty, lerr)

	root, _ := os.MkdirTemp("", "gitprobe")
	defer os.RemoveAll(root)
	bare := filepath.Join(root, "srv", "repo.git")
	_, err := git.PlainInitWithOptions(bare, &git.PlainInitOptions{
		Bare:        true,
		InitOptions: git.InitOptions{DefaultBranch: plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName("main")},
	})
	must(err, "init bare")
	seedSto := filesystem.NewStorage(osfs.New(bare), cache.NewObjectLRUDefault())
	seed, err := git.Open(seedSto, memfs.New())
	must(err, "open seed")
	wt, _ := seed.Worktree()
	f, _ := wt.Filesystem.Create("a.txt")
	f.Write([]byte("hello\n"))
	f.Close()
	wt.Add("a.txt")
	sig := &object.Signature{Name: "t", Email: "t@example.invalid", When: time.Unix(1700000000, 0).UTC()}
	c0, err := wt.Commit("C0", &git.CommitOptions{Author: sig, Committer: sig})
	must(err, "seed commit")
	fmt.Println("C0", c0)

	srv := server.NewServer(server.NewFilesystemLoader(osfs.New(filepath.Join(root, "srv"))))
	ep, _ := transport.NewEndpoint("/repo.git")
	var lastRPErr error
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/test/git/repo.git/info/refs", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		svc := r.URL.Query().Get("service")
		var ar *packp.AdvRefs
		var err error
		switch svc {
		case "git-upload-pack":
			s, e := srv.NewUploadPackSession(ep, nil)
			must(e, "up session")
			ar, err = s.AdvertisedReferencesContext(r.Context())
			s.Close()
		case "git-receive-pack":
			s, e := srv.NewReceivePackSession(ep, nil)
			must(e, "rp session")
			ar, err = s.AdvertisedReferencesContext(r.Context())
			s.Close()
		default:
			http.Error(w, "bad service", 400)
			return
		}
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), 500)
			return
		}
		ar.Prefix = [][]byte{[]byte("# service=" + svc), pktline.Flush}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/x-"+svc+"-advertisement")
		ar.Encode(w)
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("/test/git/repo.git/git-upload-pack", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		s, _ := srv.NewUploadPackSession(ep, nil)
		defer s.Close()
		req := packp.NewUploadPackRequest()
		if err := req.Decode(r.Body); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), 400)
			return
		}
		resp, err := s.UploadPack(r.Context(), req)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), 500)
			return
		}
		defer resp.Close()
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/x-git-upload-pack-result")
		resp.Encode(w)
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("/test/git/repo.git/git-receive-pack", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		s, _ := srv.NewReceivePackSession(ep, nil)
		defer s.Close()
		req := packp.NewReferenceUpdateRequest()
		if err := req.Decode(r.Body); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), 400)
			return
		}
		rs, err := s.ReceivePack(r.Context(), req)
		lastRPErr = err
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/x-git-receive-pack-result")
		if rs != nil {
			rs.Encode(w)
		}
	})
	ts := httptest.NewUnstartedServer(mux)
	ts.StartTLS()
	defer ts.Close()
	caPEM := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: ts.Certificate().Raw})
	url := ts.URL + "/test/git/repo.git"

	// Clone (worker)
	worker, err := git.Clone(memory.NewStorage(), memfs.New(), &git.CloneOptions{URL: url, CABundle: caPEM})
	must(err, "clone")
	h, _ := worker.Head()
	fmt.Println("clone HEAD", h.Hash(), "== C0:", h.Hash() == c0)
	wwt, _ := worker.Worktree()
	f, _ = wwt.Filesystem.Create("b.txt")
	f.Write([]byte("task\n"))
	f.Close()
	wwt.Add("b.txt")
	c1, err := wwt.Commit("C1", &git.CommitOptions{Author: sig, Committer: sig})
	must(err, "commit C1")
	err = worker.Push(&git.PushOptions{RefSpecs: []config.RefSpec{"refs/heads/main:refs/callsheet/tasks/t1"}, CABundle: caPEM})
	fmt.Println("push C1 -> refs/callsheet/tasks/t1 err:", err, "C1", c1)

	// Observer fetch
	obs, _ := git.Init(memory.NewStorage(), nil)
	obs.CreateRemote(&config.RemoteConfig{Name: "origin", URLs: []string{url}})
	err = obs.Fetch(&git.FetchOptions{RefSpecs: []config.RefSpec{"refs/callsheet/tasks/t1:refs/remotes/origin/t1"}, CABundle: caPEM})
	must(err, "observer fetch")
	or, _ := obs.Reference("refs/remotes/origin/t1", true)
	fmt.Println("observer fetched t1", or.Hash(), "== C1:", or.Hash() == c1)

	reopen := func() *git.Repository {
		r, err := git.PlainOpen(bare)
		must(err, "reopen")
		return r
	}
	refOf := func(name string) string {
		ref, err := reopen().Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName(name), false)
		if err != nil {
			return "absent(" + err.Error() + ")"
		}
		return ref.Hash().String()
	}
	fmt.Println("reopened bare: main", refOf("refs/heads/main"), "t1", refOf("refs/callsheet/tasks/t1"))

	emptyPack := func() io.ReadCloser {
		var b bytes.Buffer
		_, err := packfile.NewEncoder(&b, memory.NewStorage(), false).Encode(nil, 10)
		must(err, "empty pack")
		return io.NopCloser(&b)
	}
	rawPush := func(label string, cmd *packp.Command, pack io.ReadCloser) {
		req := packp.NewReferenceUpdateRequest()
		req.Capabilities.Set(capability.ReportStatus)
		req.Commands = []*packp.Command{cmd}
		req.Packfile = pack
		var body bytes.Buffer
		must(req.Encode(&body), "encode req")
		cl := ts.Client()
		resp, err := cl.Post(url+"/git-receive-pack", "application/x-git-receive-pack-request", &body)
		must(err, "post")
		out, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		resp.Body.Close()
		fmt.Printf("[%s] HTTP %d, server session err=%v, report=%q\n", label, resp.StatusCode, lastRPErr, string(out))
	}

	// Probe A: stale old-ref. Current t1 == C1; claim old == C0 (stale), new == C0 (objects present).
	rawPush("stale-old", &packp.Command{Name: "refs/callsheet/tasks/t1", Old: c0, New: c0}, emptyPack())
	fmt.Println("  after stale-old: t1 =", refOf("refs/callsheet/tasks/t1"), "(C1 =", c1, ", C0 =", c0, ")")

	// Probe B: ref to object absent from store (closure/existence check).
	ghost := plumbing.NewHash("1234567890123456789012345678901234567890")
	rawPush("missing-object", &packp.Command{Name: "refs/callsheet/tasks/ghost", Old: plumbing.ZeroHash, New: ghost}, emptyPack())
	fmt.Println("  after missing-object: ghost =", refOf("refs/callsheet/tasks/ghost"))

	// Probe C: truncated pack.
	wf, _ := wwt.Filesystem.Create("c.txt")
	wf.Write(bytes.Repeat([]byte("x"), 5000))
	wf.Close()
	wwt.Add("c.txt")
	c2, _ := wwt.Commit("C2", &git.CommitOptions{Author: sig, Committer: sig})
	have, _ := revlist.Objects(worker.Storer, []plumbing.Hash{c1}, nil)
	objs, _ := revlist.Objects(worker.Storer, []plumbing.Hash{c2}, have)
	var pb bytes.Buffer
	_, err = packfile.NewEncoder(&pb, worker.Storer, false).Encode(objs, 10)
	must(err, "pack C2")
	trunc := pb.Bytes()[:pb.Len()/2]
	rawPush("truncated", &packp.Command{Name: "refs/callsheet/tasks/t2", Old: plumbing.ZeroHash, New: c2}, io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(trunc)))
	fmt.Println("  after truncated: t2 =", refOf("refs/callsheet/tasks/t2"))

	// Probe D: task-ref push must not touch main.
	fmt.Println("main after all probes:", refOf("refs/heads/main"), "== C0:", refOf("refs/heads/main") == c0.String())
	_ = context.Background
}
